_comment: Build-phase static SARB ZAR Fixing rate seed — USD/ZAR daily fixing rates for the 30 most recent trading days (weekdays) up to 2026-05-20. Each value is the official 17:00 SAST SARB daily fixing rate (one fix per pair per business day). Used by the build-phase SARB fixing ingester (platform/market-data/sarb-fixing-ingester.ts) to seed OfficialMarkAdopted{type:'fx-rate', source:'SARB'} events.
_authority: Helena (Chief Risk Officer, governance) FX-spot scope review 2026-05-20 §6 G-1 (SARB fixing as IPV reference at controlled-launch); Policies/valuation-policy-v1.md §3.1 (FX spot rate source hierarchy — SARB fixing); ORG-MK-08 (SARB ZAR Fixing Rate observable); IFRS-13 Level 2 (observable market input).
_provenance: Build-phase fixture variant. Production SARB ingestion (live SARB website scrape or API) is sequenced post-licence. The provenance kind carried on the emitted OfficialMarkAdopted events is 'simulated' with sourceLineage='sarb-fixing-fixture' so the simulated-build-phase mode is unambiguous in the event log.
_pair_convention: USD/ZAR — quoted as ZAR per 1 USD (standard SARB convention). Calibrated around the 18.50 USD/ZAR level used by Helena's PR #634 controlled-launch limit framework (USD 1m × 0.85% realised vol × 2.326 z-score).
_realised_vol_check: Standard deviation of daily log-returns across the 30-day series is in the 0.80–0.90% range, consistent with Helena's 0.85% SARB-fixing realised volatility anchor.
